headline.text: Part of 6+ rebrands. He led two of them: QuantumStreet AI (from Equbot, with Digitas) and Airtel B2B (with Wolff Olins).
He created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.
VP Marketing, Happay: 161% ARR growth. 2x exit: to CRED ($180M), then MakeMyTrip.
VP Global Performance Marketing, Locus: $4.2M pipeline. Acquired by IKEA (Ingka Group) in Oct 2025.
Fractional CMO, FieldAssist: 2.25x growth in mid-market and enterprise qualified leads.
Advisor, QuantumStreet AI: rebranded a $7Bn AUM AI investment fund, with Digitas and IBM.
4x business growth, Airtel Data Centers and Managed Services.

frameworks.name: EPIC
frameworks.description: Ecosystem and ABM, Product-Led Growth, Inbound and Outbound, Community-Led. It scores the four go-to-market motions from 1 to 10 for your stage, deal size, sales cycle and market, and names the one to lead with.

frameworks.name: IMPACT
frameworks.description: Identify Champions, Map Alternatives, Pinpoint Value, Anchor Market, Craft Message, Translate Execution: six steps from the buyer who wants you to a message your team can use.

frameworks.name: CRAFT
frameworks.description: Character, Result, Artifact, Frame, Timeline: the five things to tell an AI assistant so its answer is specific instead of generic.

frameworks.name: Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology
frameworks.description: A methodology for effective branding, created by Shashwat Ghosh.

craftTemplates.name: CRAFT: 50 AI Context Engineering for Business

services.name: Fractional CMO
services.description: Shashwat leads marketing inside the company as your Fractional CMO. He owns the marketing and demand generation plans, builds and mentors the team, sets up processes and spend, tracks the few results that matter each quarter, and is a sounding board for the executive team.

services.name: EPIC motion choice
services.description: Scores the four go-to-market motions for your stage, deal size, sales cycle and market, and names the one to lead with.

services.name: Positioning
services.description: The IMPACT framework finds the market you can own and the message to win it.

connectors.name: GTM Alpha
connectors.description: Scores the four EPIC go-to-market motions from 1 to 10 with Shashwat Ghosh's documented rubric and names the one to lead with. The web app gives a 180 day plan; in Claude you choose 30, 60 or 90 days.

connectors.name: CRAFT GTM
connectors.description: Eight planning tools: a product-market fit scorecard, launch plans, interview guides, retention, partner and crisis playbooks, battle cards and a CRAFT review of GTM documents.

connectors.name: CRAFT Content
connectors.description: Eight content tools: case studies, newsletters, webinar scripts, repurposed posts, thought leadership series, testimonial requests, sales content and a CRAFT review of drafts.

connectors.name: IMPACT
connectors.description: Eight positioning tools on the IMPACT framework: champions, alternatives, value, market anchor, message and execution, plus a full audit and the framework guide.

connectors.name: ICP Intelligence
connectors.description: Nine ideal customer profile tools: deep dive, scoring model, buying group, TAM, SAM and SOM, lookalikes, account priorities, gaps, changes over time and interview themes.

connectors.name: Revenue Enablement
connectors.description: Twelve sales tools: account plans, deal strategy, discovery questions, ROI cases, mutual action plans, win and loss reviews, proposals, emails, demos, pricing, champions and competitive traps.

testimonials.author: Suryadeep Verma
testimonials.headline: Chief Marketing Officer at Comviva Technologies
testimonials.text: Shashwat is an extremely astute and intelligent marketing professional. One of the rare breed to marketers that are able to strategically plan and execute programs with equal diligence. Has an extremely balanced and well-rounded perspective on any initiative. Always a great team person and colleague to depend on.

testimonials.author: Naveen Surapaneni
testimonials.headline: Strategy | Business Development | Marketing | B2B Sales | Sales Operations
testimonials.text: Shashwat is a passionate marketing professional with a successful track record of nurturing and building strong B2B brands. His sharp insights, strong creative flair and understanding of technology landscape, has enabled him to conceptualize and launch impactful marketing programmes and campaigns. Shaswat displayed tremendous collaborative skills to build robust marketing ecosystem including diverse internal and external stakeholders. With his rounded experience of working both on agency as well as client side, he was able to get the best out of the agency partners. It was a pleasure working with Shaswat. Wishing him all the very best for his future endeavors.

testimonials.author: Debashish Duttagupta
testimonials.headline: Business Head, Strategic Partner Acquisition and Growth at Ageas Federal Life Insurance
testimonials.text: @Shashwat is Sharp, Analytical, Tenacious, Resilient, Confident, Intelligent, Creative and has tremendous amount of Common Sense to lead & manage People and Business !

testimonials.author: Rajendra Gupta
testimonials.headline: Marketing & Communications Professional
testimonials.text: Shashwat and I worked together during the initial phase of Reliance Infocom. He is not only strategically strong, but also a very hard working guy. I wish him all the very best in his future endeavours

testimonials.author: Kunwar B. Kishore Arora
testimonials.headline: CEO | MD | COO
testimonials.text: When I was building the Data Center and Managed Services business from inception, Shashwat and his team did an exceptional job in brand building and communication. He worked closely with my team and successfully executed the marketing plans. For existing Airtel Customers they launched account based marketing and for new customers it was through leading technology events and IT magazines. We grew the DC & MS business by 4X in 3 Years.

testimonials.author: Ravindra Pamadi
testimonials.headline: Sr GM-Finance at Wunderman
testimonials.text: Shashwat is an advertising professional with a straight forward approach. He is down to earth simple and friendly. At work, he is confident,reliable,dedicated, meticulous, target oriented and above all patient.He is a lovable person and comes across as a reliable guy.

testimonials.author: Soumitra Agarwal
testimonials.headline: Managing Partner at Horton International
testimonials.text: Shashwat is a creative and result-oriented professional and I was impressed with the work he is doing at Reliance Infocomm. He has a good understanding of how a message needs to be conveyed via graphical and textual elements and delivers on time.

testimonials.author: Tuhin Chakraborty
testimonials.headline: Chief Business Officer, POSSIBLE
testimonials.text: Shashwat is one of those quintessential client, that a agency guy would always look forward to meeting on the other side of the table...basically one who has straddled both the sides. Honest, sincere, hard-working with a never-say-die attitude, always willing to share responsibilities and bring out the best.

testimonials.author: Vineet Nigam
testimonials.headline: Head, International Business & Strategy at Reliance Jio Infocomm
testimonials.text: I have known Shashwat for over 4 years now and have developed a great admiration for his sheer marketing creativity, event management skills, supplier handling and his forever bouyant positive spirit. His positive atitude and delivering under pressure is remarkable. He is a great marketing guy and will give you the comfort levels under the most stressful circumstances. All the best to him!!

testimonials.author: Shyam Bhethanabotla
testimonials.headline: GTM Engineering, Enterprise Agentic AI platforms and Solutions
testimonials.text: Shaswat is a sharp-shooter and fun to work with.

testimonials.headline: Founder at Telco Partners, Founder at Rohavi Technologies
